Liam van Looveren

Liam is a co-owner of Hotwire Interactive, contributing to the studio’s direction and bringing a lifelong passion for games.

A lifelong gamer, Liam has always been fascinated by the development of the games industry. He brings that experience and curiosity to Hotwire Interactive, with a focus on what’s best for the game and the people playing it.

When he’s not deep in new ideas, you’ll find him on the football pitch — in a game or in real life. A dedicated supporter of the sport, he brings the same enthusiasm to helping the studio grow.
